Tim: Quick sync — scheduling a design review for the new API/SDK + Console UX surface. Proposed slots: Tue 9–10am PDT, Wed 3–4pm PDT, Fri 11–12pm PDT. Pre-read: https://redwood-internal/docs/design-reviews/sdk-console-pre-read and PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/312. Please vote with emoji and drop any extra agenda items.
Lara: +1 Tue works for me, prefer morning. :thumbsup:
Priya: Wed afternoon is rough for me (oncall). Can we avoid Wed 3p? :slightly_frowning_face:
Mike: Fri 11 looks good. Also request 10–15 min at the end for the canary rollout plan + perf numbers.
Sam: Heads up — I'll be OOO Tue morning. I can do Wed if we can move it to 2pm instead of 3. Otherwise Fri is safest.
Rebecca: UX will join. Will add prototype links to the pre-read in a few mins: https://figma.com/file/abc123/sdk-console-v2 — want to cover form flows + error states.
Tim: Thanks — updated note: looking for three reviewers (eng: Mike/Sam, UX: Rebecca, PM: Lara). If Fri wins let's make it a focused 60m with demo + 15m for Q&A and rollout.
Priya: If we pick Fri can we get the pre-read deadline = Thu EOD so I can skim before weekend? Otherwise I'll be blind oncall Fri.
Lara: Agree with Thu EOD pre-read. Also add an agenda item: API contract backwards-compatibility and migration plan.
Sam: Small checklist for reviewers (copying here):
```
- Read pre-read doc
- Try quick local example (link in doc)
- Flag any breaking changes
- Note UX edge cases
- Perf/regression concerns
```
Rebecca: I'll add the UX testing checklist and short screen recording to the doc by EOD Thu.
calendar-bot: Created a Doodle poll: https://doodle.com/poll/xyz123 — please vote. I'll post the final calendar invite once slot confirmed.
Tim: Cool — action items: everyone vote on Doodle, reviewers mark availability, Rebecca + Tim update pre-read + demo artifacts by Thu EOD, Mike prep perf slides. I'll ping again in ~12h with current tally. Thanks! :rocket:
